summary.zh: 用 profile 定位并优化性能瓶颈
summary.en: Profile slow Python code and fix the real bottlenecks.

description.zh: 先用 cProfile 和内存分析器找出耗时、占内存的位置，再按性能实践逐项优化。适合接口变慢、批处理跑太久或内存持续上涨时排查。
description.en: Locates the truly expensive parts with cProfile and memory profilers, then optimizes them using established practices. Use it when endpoints get slow, batch jobs take too long or memory keeps climbing.
